source_row.stem: A client with severe lithium toxicity and a very high serum level may require which treatment?
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Hemodialysis, in severe cases, to rapidly remove lithium from the body","B":"Oral fluids only","C":"No treatment is available for this particular kind of toxicity","D":"Increased lithium dose"}}
source_row.rationale: In cases of severe lithium toxicity with very high serum levels or significant symptoms, hemodialysis may be required to rapidly remove lithium from the body, in addition to supportive care.
source_row.source_name: Clinical Toxicology References — Severe Lithium Toxicity Management
